User gained admin secret read via groups claim mapping, exceeding role intent (group-policy escalation).

sequences.description: Attack empty_audience: role configured with bound_audiences=[]; attacker presents JWT with arbitrary aud and attempts to read a protected secret.
sequences.invariant_hypothesis: I5: A JWT with an audience not explicitly allowed by BrokerPolicy (role bound_audiences) must not yield permissions; empty bound_audiences must not behave as allow-any.

params.description: jwt mount for I5 empty_audience test

oracle_checks.violation_description: Role with empty bound_audiences accepted arbitrary aud and granted read access (empty audience behaved like allow-any).
Role config could not be read back; test setup invalid so authorization-binding result is ambiguous.

sequences.description: Attack default_role confusion: mount default_role initially points to a privileged role; then admin changes default_role to a restricted role. Attacker omits role on login to see if old default_role is still used (stale config) and can read privileged secret.
sequences.invariant_hypothesis: I5: Effective permissions for a login that omits role must be bounded by the CURRENT mount-level default_role and its policy; after default_role change, new logins must not retain old privileges.

params.description: jwt mount for I5 default_role change test

oracle_checks.violation_description: After default_role was changed to restricted-default-role, a role-omitted login still accessed privileged secret (stale/incorrect default_role binding).
Role-omitted login did not behave like the new restricted default role; indicates misbinding or unexpected policy application.

sequences.description: Attack identity_policy_override: create a userpass entity with an admin policy, then login via JWT as a different principal and check whether the JWT login incorrectly inherits the preexisting entity's policies (authorization over-grant).
sequences.invariant_hypothesis: I5: JWT-authenticated sessions must not gain policies from an unrelated preexisting entity; effective permissions must be limited to role-granted policies and correctly bound identity.

params.description: jwt mount for I5 identity policy override test

oracle_checks.violation_description: JWT low-priv role session could read admin secret, indicating policy over-grant beyond role intent (possible identity policy override).
JWT low-priv role session could not read low-priv secret; setup may be broken, making over-grant results ambiguous.
JWT login mapped to the same entity as a preexisting privileged userpass entity and inherited its permissions (authorization binding failure).

sequences.description: Attack: role uses empty bound_claims={} (misconfiguration) — ensure it does NOT silently bypass authorization intent and grant access to protected secret
sequences.invariant_hypothesis: I5: If a role is intended to restrict by claims, an empty bound_claims must not result in over-broad authorization; attacker JWT should not gain access to protected resources without satisfying intended constraints.

params.description: jwt mount for I5 tests

oracle_checks.violation_description: Control login failed or could not read allowed public secret; setup invalid for I5 comparison
Control user unexpectedly read admin secret; policy binding broken in baseline
Role with empty claim constraints allowed attacker to read admin secret (over-grant beyond intended claim restriction)

sequences.description: Attack: role uses claim_constraints {'sub':'*'} with glob matching — ensure wildcard does not unintentionally grant access to privileged secret to arbitrary subjects
sequences.invariant_hypothesis: I5: Even if glob matching is enabled, wildcard claim constraints must not expand authorization beyond broker policy intent; privileged access should remain denied unless explicitly granted.

params.description: jwt mount for I5 glob tests

oracle_checks.violation_description: Control admin-subject login failed; cannot compare wildcard behavior reliably
Wildcard sub constraint allowed arbitrary subject to read admin secret (authorization over-grant)

sequences.description: Attack: role is tightened (policy reduced) but attacker re-auth still gets old privileges — tests stale authorization binding after config change
sequences.invariant_hypothesis: I5: After broker policy/role changes, new logins must not retain previously granted permissions; effective permissions must reflect current BrokerPolicy(config).

params.description: jwt mount for I5 role-tighten tests

oracle_checks.violation_description: Baseline login failed; cannot evaluate stale-privilege behavior
After role tighten, new login still read admin secret (stale authorization binding / over-grant)

sequences.description: Attempt to bypass audience binding by sending JWT aud as a list containing an allowed audience plus an attacker-controlled audience; verify Vault does not over-grant access compared to a strict single-audience token.
sequences.invariant_hypothesis: I5: Effective permissions must not exceed BrokerPolicy(role bound_audiences) ∩ UpstreamIntent(aud). A token whose aud includes an untrusted audience should not be accepted if audience validation is strict and exact.

params.description: jwt mount for I5 audience list confusion test

oracle_checks.violation_description: Control login failed; cannot evaluate audience-binding behavior reliably
Control user unexpectedly read admin secret; baseline authorization binding is broken
JWT with aud as a list including an attacker audience was accepted and enabled admin secret access; audience binding may be bypassed via aud type confusion
